name: usage-mod
description: Your Claude Code usage as colored chips above the prompt: 5h and weekly limits (% left), session cost and spend history. /usage-mod opens the full view.

refreshMinutes.title: Spend refresh minutes
refreshMinutes.description: How often the transcripts are re-read for Today, Yesterday and 30-day spend

view.title: Band
view.description: Show the chip band above the prompt

showSpend.title: Show today spend
showSpend.description: Add a Today spend chip to the band on wide screens

planRefreshMinutes.title: Plan limits refresh minutes
planRefreshMinutes.description: How often Anthropic's plan usage API is asked for Fable, extra usage and resets (5 at the least). Every open session shares one reply, and a session with no turn waits up to 30 minutes.

planLimits.title: Plan limits from Anthropic
planLimits.description: Ask Anthropic's plan usage API (what /usage reads) for the limits Claude Code does not report, such as Fable and extra usage. Uses your signed-in session through Claude Code; the token never reaches the mod.

interactive.title: Tooltips and animation (desktop)
interactive.description: Draw the band and pane as interactive SVG: hover tooltips and Pac-Man's chomp. The desktop app redraws an interactive SVG by reloading its frame, so turn this off if the band flickers.
